table.retrieve:
SELECT
	itemname = case WHEN max(srdetail.Alternatecustomicode) is null OR srdetail.Alternatecustomicode = '' then item.name else (SELECT AI.Name FROM AlternateItemAlias AI WHERE AI.ICode=srdetail.icode AND srdetail.Alternatecustomicode = AI.CustomICode) end, 
	aliasname=max(item.customicode),
	alternatecustomicode=isnull(max(srdetail.Alternatecustomicode),'  '),
	alternatepackingdesc=isnull((select packingdesc from AlternateItemAlias where AlternateItemAlias.customicode=max(srdetail.Alternatecustomicode)),''),
	alternateitemqty= isnull((select qty from AlternateItemAlias where AlternateItemAlias.customicode=max(srdetail.Alternatecustomicode)),1),
	headerno=max(srledger.headerno),
	dbo.users.username,  
	srcatcode=max(srledger.srcatcode),
	accname = accounts.name, 
	customeralias=(select accounts.aliasname from accounts where acccode=max(srledger.custcode)),
	dbo.srledger.srinvcode,   
	dbo.srledger.saleinvcode, 
	dbo.srledger.date,   
	dbo.srledger.discperc,   
	dbo.srledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.srledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.srledger.salestax,   
	dbo.srledger.remarks,   
	looseqty = Sum(dbo.srdetail.looseqty),   
	packqty  = Sum(dbo.srdetail.packqty),   
	icode = Max(dbo.srdetail.icode),   
	srprice = Max(dbo.srdetail.srprice),   
	itemnetrate=(  max(srdetail.srprice) )  *  ( 1 -  (   srdetail.discperc  * .01 )  )  ,
	discperc = Max(dbo.srdetail.discperc) ,
	unitsalestax=max(srdetail.unitsalestax),
	itemgstperc=max(srdetail.gstperc),
	invgstperc=max(srledger.invgstperc1),
	reprintingcounter=max(srledger.reprintingcounter),
	currentbalance= (select isnull(sum(v.debit - v.credit), 0) from virtualgl v
							where v.acccode=max(accounts.acccode) group by v.acccode),
					  
	serverdate=getdate(),
	rowid = MAX(srdetail.rowid)
FROM 
	dbo.srledger,   
	dbo.srdetail,  
	customer, 
	accounts, 
	item,
	users 
WHERE 
	( dbo.srledger.srinvcode= :ra_InvCode ) AND 
	( dbo.srledger.srinvcode= dbo.srdetail.srinvcode) AND 
	( dbo.srledger.custcode = dbo.customer.custcode) AND 
	( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode) AND 
	( dbo.srledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode) AND 
	( srdetail.icode = item.icode ) 
GROUP BY 
	dbo.srledger.srinvcode, 
	dbo.srledger.saleinvcode, 
	dbo.srledger.date, 
	dbo.srledger.discperc, 
	dbo.srledger.flatdisc, 
	dbo.srledger.misccharges, 
	dbo.srledger.salestax, 
	dbo.srledger.remarks,
	dbo.srdetail.srprice,
 	dbo.srdetail.discperc,
	dbo.srdetail.gstperc,
	dbo.srdetail.unitsalestax,
	srdetail.icode,
	dbo.item.name, 
	item.customicode,
	srdetail.Alternatecustomicode,
	dbo.accounts.name, 
	dbo.users.username
ORDER BY
	RowID

objects.name: c_sumitemleveltaxval
objects.expression: sum( unitsalestax * looseqty  + Round( c_amount  * 0.01 *  itemgstperc , 2) for all)

objects.name: compute_6
objects.expression: sum(if(mod(looseqty, alternateitemqty )=0 ,( looseqty/if( alternateitemqty=0,1,alternateitemqty)  )  ,  looseqty) for all)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round(sum( c_amount ) * (1 -  srledger_discperc  * .01) -  srledger_flatdisc  +  srledger_misccharges  +  srledger_salestax , 0)  + Round(Round( (Round( sum (c_amount for all) * (1 - 0.01 *  srledger_discperc ) ,2) -  srledger_flatdisc ) * 0.01 *  invgstperc  ,2 )  + sum( c_salestaxval for all) ,0)

objects.name: c_totalsalestax
objects.expression: Round( (sum (c_amount for all) * 0.01 *  srledger_discperc) * ( 1 -  srledger_flatdisc ) * (invgstperc  *  0.01) ,2)  + Round(sum( c_salestaxval for all) ,0)

objects.name: c_total_disc
objects.expression: Round(Sum(c_amount) *  srledger_discperc  * .01 , 2) +srledger_flatdisc + sum(Round( ( looseqty  *  srdetail_srprice  )  *    (   srdetail_discperc  * .01 )   , 2) for all)

objects.name: compute_19
objects.expression: Round(sum( c_amount ) * (1 -  srledger_discperc  * .01) -  srledger_flatdisc  +  srledger_misccharges  +  srledger_salestax , 0)  + Round(Round( (Round( sum (c_amount for all) * (1 - 0.01 *  srledger_discperc ) ,2) -  srledger_flatdisc ) * 0.01 *  invgstperc  ,2 )  + sum( c_salestaxval for all) ,0)

objects.name: compute_21
objects.expression: currentbalance - Round(sum( c_amount ) * (1 -  srledger_discperc  * .01) -  srledger_flatdisc  +  srledger_misccharges  +  srledger_salestax , 0)  + Round(Round( (Round( sum (c_amount for all) * (1 - 0.01 *  srledger_discperc ) ,2) -  srledger_flatdisc ) * 0.01 *  invgstperc  ,2 )  + sum( c_salestaxval for all) ,0)
